messages:
rene: Idea: 'Relay Thanks' program — managers start a postcard chain where each recipient signs a quick note and passes it along to someone who helped them. small physical chain, ends with 1line highlight + tiny enamel pin for the final recipient. low budget, high meaning.
tiago: Interesting. How long a chain and who kicks it off?
rene: Thinking 5 hops per chain, start with 20 starter packs across teams. Each pack = 5 blank postcards + instructions + a map sticker to show the chain.
maddie: Logistics q: do we need HR approval for manager-initiated recognition? want to avoid any perceived pressure to participate.
hr-bot: Quick note: informal peer appreciation is allowed. Ensure participation is opt-in and that no performance evaluations are tied to it. Add an opt-out line on the instruction card.
tiago: Vendor lead times? enamel pins usually 7 business days. postcards are 2 days from local print shop.
maddie: Budget estimate: 100 postcards $30, 50 enamel pins (for chain ends) $160, printed instruction stickers $15, packing materials $10, shipping ~$25 = ~$240.
accounts: That fits small events spend. Please route to the PeopleOps card and upload receipts.
rene: Volunteer plan: need 3 people for assembly night (pack postcards + instructions) and 2 people to coordinate distribution to team leads. Who's available?
tiago: I can do distribution and coord with eng leads.
maddie: I'll run assembly night Tue 6-8pm and handle the instruction copy.
mailroom-bot: Reminder: internal delivery manifest required 48 hours prior for scheduled drop. For kits >50 please allow 72 hours.
rene: For fairness: we'll invite managers to sign up; participation is optional. Also include a line: "If you'd prefer not to receive a postcard, DM @rene."
tiago: Nice. Can we include a QR code linking to a digital relay option for remote folks?
maddie: Yes. I'll create a simple form that mirrors the postcard flow so remote employees can participate. QR on the instruction card + a short URL.
rene: Accessibility: volunteers will offer to transcribe messages if someone prefers to dictate. Add that to the instructions.
accounts: Also add expense tag EVENTS_RELAY so finance can reconcile easily.
maddie: I'll draft the instruction card copy: short steps, opt-in note, privacy reminder (no performance comments), and where to get more info. Posting here in an hour for feedback.
tiago: For measurement: let's track number of completed chains and any qualitative quotes for comms. not a full survey, just 1 optional sentence from the final recipient.
rene: Good point. post-event: collect 3 micro-quotes and 1 photo for an internal comms post.
mailroom-bot: ACTION: submit kit manifest by Thu 5pm to ship kits Fri.
maddie: If prints needed faster, I can print in-house and assemble same-day. less pretty but faster.
tiago: Could also seed a few kits into satellite offices via local coordinators. I'll ping APAC lead to see if they'd like a small batch.
rene: Checklist: instruction copy (maddie), order pins & postcards (maddie/rene), volunteer assembly (maddie), distribution list (tiago), finance code (accounts). Will update thread when copy is ready. :sparkles:
